records.subject: DTC
records.title: Introduction to Digital Technology and Culture
records.description: Inquiry into digital media, including origins, theories, forms, applications, and impact with a focus on authoring and critiquing multimodal texts.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Tools and Methods for Digital Technology
records.description: An introduction to the tools and methods of production for multimedia authoring in digital contexts.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Internet Revolutions
records.description: Introduction to the technologies and technical cultures that gave rise to the global information infrastructure supporting contemporary communication platforms.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Introduction to Text Analysis
records.description: Introduction to computational and statistical text analysis using the open source programming language R; designed for students with no prior experience with programming but who wish to extend their methodological tool kit to include quantitative and computational approaches to the study of text.  (Crosslisted course offered as DTC 204, DATA 204.)

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Digital Inclusion
records.description: Examination of global reach of digital environments, structures, and tools with focus on inclusion in terms of access, availability, affordability, adoption, and application across cultures.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Introduction to Digital Cinema
records.description: A practical introduction to the technological and cultural transformations driving the evolution of cinematic techniques from the birth of motion pictures to emerging technology.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Visualizing Data
records.description: Introduction to the tools and methods of visually communicating data for diverse audiences and scenarios.  (Crosslisted course offered as DTC 209, DATA 209.)

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Professional Preparation
records.description: Development of materials and skills to prepare for entry into technology or media professions.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Social Media Case Studies
records.description: Inquiry into ways businesses and individuals use social media as a marketing tool with special emphasis on media impact.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Social Media Practices
records.description: Inquiry into social media practices from a ground-up approach, focusing on social media message creation and consumption; online self-presentation; online relationships; reputation management; social media data analysis.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: 3D Digital Animation
records.description: 3D digital animation for creative and professional productions, art skills, story-telling and team problem-solving techniques.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Multimedia Design
records.description: Design practices and process for composing for a multimedia environment including color, pattern, and shape.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Illustration Beyond Boundaries: Concept Design and Character Development
records.description: Translation of creative vision into effective imagery for both personal projects and professional applications through critique, research, and conceptual thinking.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Special Topics in Digital Technology and Culture
records.description: Major trends or artists in digital technology and culture.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Digital Storytelling
records.description: Nonlinear, multi-linear, and interactive narrative using elements of creative writing such as character, dialog, setting, plot and image. (Crosslisted course offered as DTC 354, ENGLISH 354.)

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Introduction to Web Design and Development
records.description: Introduction to design, development, and coding for the world wide web and interactive media.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Information Structures
records.description: Social and cultural role of information; research with electronic sources; production, validation, storage, retrieval, evaluation, use, impact of electronic information.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Language, Texts and Technology
records.description: Relationship between technology and communication; writing practices from a historical point of view.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Video Games Theories and Histories
records.description: History and theory of video games with a focus on innovation and cultural impact.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Advanced Animation
records.description: Advanced investigation of tools and methods for 2D and 3D digital animation.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Advanced Multimedia Design
records.description: Advanced design principles and projects in digital media; projects include visual, sound, haptic, and interactive experiences.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Digital Diversity
records.description: Cultural impact of digital media in cultural contexts; issues of race, class, gender, sexuality online.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Digital Strategies
records.description: Examines multiple digital strategies for engagement with immersive and emerging technologies.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Advanced Web Design and Development
records.description: Advanced web development and coding for creating interactive media and websites.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Usability and Interface Design
records.description: Design of websites using best practices of visual literacy, interface architecture, and usability.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Advanced Digital Cinema
records.description: Exploration of advanced techniques, theories, and aesthetic strategies of cinema in the age of digital media.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Engines and Platforms
records.description: A study of software platforms and engines used for media design, with special focus on intuitive tools, rapid work flow, multimedia platform environments, and asset management.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Senior Studio
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Completion of Writing Portfolio; admitted to the major in Digital Technology and Culture; senior standing.
records.description: Individual multimedia project production with special focus on project management, disciplinary-specific workflows (cinema and animation, game design, web design and development, digital design), planning, creative exploration and execution.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Senior Seminar
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Completion of Junior Writing Portfolio; admitted to the major in Digital Technology and Culture; senior standing.
records.description: Major multimedia project for nonprofit organization or small business with special focus on project management, planning, and execution.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Internship
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  By department permission; admitted to the major in Digital Technology and Culture; junior standing.
records.description: Direct professional learning experiences in the area of digital media, technology, and culture.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: DTC
records.title: Special Problems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Admitted to the major in Digital Technology and Culture; junior standing.
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
